edits.before:
::method showDocuments
  expose app screen table detail mode status
  docs = app~allDocuments
  table = self~tableFromDocuments(docs)
  screen~table = table
  screen~detail = .nil
  screen~form = .nil
  detail = .nil
  mode = "LIST"
  if table~count > 0 then do
    table~select(1)
    self~selectTableIdentity
  end
  status = "Documents: " || docs~items
  return self
edits.after:
::method showDocuments
  expose app screen table detail mode status listOffset listPageSize listTotal listSource
  /* Consume the existing renderer-neutral bounded semantic window. The
   * application still owns sorting and documents; the CLI never constructs
   * thousands of rows when only a visible page is required. */
  listSource = "documents"
  range = app~semanticCollectionRange("documents", listOffset, listPageSize)
  listTotal = range["TOTAL"]
  if listTotal > 0 & listOffset >= listTotal then do
    listOffset = 0
    range = app~semanticCollectionRange("documents", 0, listPageSize)
  end
  table = self~tableFromSemanticRows(range["ROWS"])
  screen~table = table
  screen~detail = .nil
  screen~form = .nil
  detail = .nil
  mode = "LIST"
  if table~count > 0 then do
    table~select(1)
    self~selectTableIdentity
  end
  first = 0
  last = 0
  if table~count > 0 then do
    first = listOffset + 1
    last = listOffset + table~count
  end
  status = "Documents " || first || "-" || last || " of " || listTotal || ". PAGE NEXT/PREVIOUS."
  return self

::method tableFromSemanticRows
  expose app
  use strict arg semanticRows
  columns = .array~of("KEY", "TYPE", "TITLE", "STATUS", "DEPS")
  model = .CliUiTableModel~new(columns)
  do item over semanticRows
    /* DependsOn is not a scalar in the collection contract. Resolve only
     * visible rows; do not expand the contract or duplicate domain truth. */
    document = app~node~document(item["IDENTITY"])
    if document == .nil then raise syntax 93.900 array("Missing NotNotes document for semantic collection identity")
    cells = .array~of(item["KEY"], item["FORM"], item["TITLE"], item["STATUS"], document~DependsOn)
    model~append(item["IDENTITY"], cells)
  end
  return model
